messages.subject: For Adaire Fox-Martin | Data centers, government relations and responsible infrastructure growth
messages.body:
Dear Equinix Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Ms. Adaire Fox-Martin, Chief Executive Officer and President.

Equinix's global data-center expansion increasingly depends on disciplined alignment across governments, utilities, communities, sustainability commitments and infrastructure partners. That interface closely matches the work I lead today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I also support stakeholder governance around a large industrial solar and battery-storage platform and coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating data.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, sustainability and infrastructure stakeholder strategy might support Equinix's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Equinix.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
